# Bossfit Wellness Club - Project Instructions

## Project Overview
Modern, responsive website for Bossfit Wellness Club gym in Dominican Republic. Inspired by SmartFit with improved design and functionality.

## Project Structure
```
bossfit/
├── index.html              # Main HTML file
├── css/styles.css         # All styling and responsive design
├── js/main.js             # Interactive functionality
├── assets/
│   ├── images/            # Website images
│   └── icons/             # Logo and favicon
└── README.md              # Complete documentation
```

## Key Features Implemented
- ✅ Responsive Design (Desktop, Tablet, Mobile)
- ✅ Hero Section with CTA
- ✅ Features Grid (6 benefits)
- ✅ Membership Plans (3 tiers)
- ✅ Classes Section (4 types)
- ✅ Locations Section (3 branches: Barrio Landia, Plaza Pablo Mella, Parque Las Toronjas)
- ✅ Testimonials
- ✅ Contact Form with Validation
- ✅ Mobile Menu Toggle
- ✅ Smooth Scrolling
- ✅ Scroll Animations
- ✅ Professional Styling

## Colors and Branding
- Primary: #FF6B35 (Orange)
- Secondary: #004E89 (Dark Blue)
- Accent: #F77F00 (Gold)
- Success: #06D6A0 (Green)

## Next Steps for Customization

### 1. Add Assets
- Place logo at: `assets/images/logo.png` (200x200px recommended)
- Add class images: `assets/images/{class-name}.jpg` (400x300px)
- Add hero image: `assets/images/hero-image.jpg` (1200x600px)

### 2. Update Content
- Contact information for each location (Barrio Landia, Plaza Pablo Mella, Parque Las Toronjas) ✅
- Hours: Mon-Fri 5:00 A.M. - 11:00 P.M. | Sat 7:00 A.M. - 8:00 P.M. | Sun Closed ✅
- Add social media links in footer
- Customize class schedules and descriptions
- Update membership plan details

### 3. Personalization
- Change company name and slogan
- Update location and hours
- Add team member information
- Customize testimonials with real member quotes
- Add gallery images

## Browser Support
- Chrome (latest)
- Firefox (latest)
- Safari (latest)
- Edge (latest)
- Mobile browsers

## Mobile Responsive Breakpoints
- Desktop: 1200px+
- Tablet: 768px - 1199px
- Mobile: < 768px

## Performance Optimization
- Minify CSS and JS for production
- Optimize images with appropriate sizes
- Consider lazy loading for images
- Compress assets

## Development Notes
- No external frameworks used (vanilla HTML/CSS/JS)
- All animations use CSS3
- Form validation handled with JavaScript
- Mobile menu implemented with vanilla JS
- Intersection Observer used for scroll animations
